title: Add Chat, Shortspot Sharing in Chat, and Shadows Follow System

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to support a direct messaging system: store conversations between two users (identified by principal), store messages with sender, timestamp, text content, and an optional shortspot reference (post ID). Expose functions: sendMessage(recipientPrincipal, text, ?postId), getConversations(), getMessages(otherPrincipal), and markMessagesRead(otherPrincipal).
acceptanceCriteria: sendMessage stores a message linked to the sender and recipient principals
getConversations returns all conversation partners for the authenticated caller, with the last message preview and unread count
getMessages returns the full message thread between caller and another principal
Messages with a postId reference store the shortspot ID correctly

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to support a follow system: users can follow/unfollow other users. Store follow relationships as (follower principal → followed principal). Expose functions: followUser(targetPrincipal), unfollowUser(targetPrincipal), getFollowers(principal), getFollowing(principal), isFollowing(targetPrincipal). The follower count on a user's profile should be called 'Shadows'.
acceptanceCriteria: followUser adds the follow relationship and creates an in-app notification for the followed user
unfollowUser removes the follow relationship
getFollowers returns all principals who follow a given user (their Shadows)
getFollowing returns all principals a given user follows
isFollowing returns a boolean for whether the caller follows a given principal

requirements.text: Extend the backend actor to support in-app notifications. Store notifications per user principal with fields: type (e.g. 'new_shadow', 'message'), fromPrincipal, timestamp, read status, and optional postId. Expose functions: getNotifications(), markNotificationRead(notificationId). Automatically create a notification when a user is followed (type = 'new_shadow').
acceptanceCriteria: A 'new_shadow' notification is created for the followed user whenever followUser is called
getNotifications returns all notifications for the authenticated caller sorted by timestamp descending
markNotificationRead marks the given notification as read
Unread notification count is accessible so the frontend can display a badge

requirements.text: Replace the existing mock-based MessagesPage with a fully functional chat page. Display a conversation list showing all conversations with avatar, display name, last message preview, and unread count badge. Clicking a conversation opens the chat thread. The thread shows message bubbles (sent messages right-aligned, received left-aligned) with timestamps. Include a text input and Send button. Add a 'Share Shortspot' button that opens a post picker modal listing the user's or recent shortspot posts; selecting one sends it as a special message containing the post reference. Auto-refresh messages every 5 seconds using polling.
acceptanceCriteria: Conversation list loads from getConversations() and auto-refreshes every 5 seconds
Clicking a conversation opens the message thread loaded from getMessages()
Messages auto-refresh every 5 seconds inside the thread view
Text messages can be sent and appear immediately (optimistic update) in the thread
A shortspot share button in the chat input opens a modal to pick a shortspot post
Shared shortspots appear in the thread as a tappable card that navigates to the full shortspot view
Unread message count badge is shown on the conversation list items and on the Messages nav icon

requirements.text: Add a Follow / Shadows feature to user profile pages (UserProfilePage and ProfilePage). On a public user's profile (UserProfilePage), show a Follow/Unfollow button for authenticated users. Display the Shadows count (follower count) prominently on all profile pages with the label 'Shadows'. Also display Following count. The Follow button should call followUser and trigger an optimistic UI update.
acceptanceCriteria: UserProfilePage shows a Follow button for authenticated users who are not already following; shows Unfollow if already following
Clicking Follow calls followUser and updates the Shadows count optimistically
Both ProfilePage (own profile) and UserProfilePage show 'Shadows: N' and 'Following: N' counts
Unauthenticated users see the Shadows count but cannot follow without logging in (show login prompt)

requirements.text: Add an in-app notifications panel accessible from the TopBar (bell icon with unread badge). The panel lists notifications including 'new_shadow' events (e.g. '@username started shadowing you'). Each notification shows the type, sender avatar, message, and timestamp. Clicking a notification marks it as read and navigates to the relevant profile or content. Poll for new notifications every 15 seconds.
acceptanceCriteria: A bell icon in the TopBar shows a red badge with the unread notification count when > 0
Clicking the bell opens a dropdown or sheet listing all notifications
New shadow notifications display the follower's avatar and handle with text 'started shadowing you'
Clicking a notification marks it read and navigates to the follower's profile
Notifications poll every 15 seconds and the badge count updates automatically

requirements.text: Add a Messages icon/tab to the BottomNav or TopBar that navigates to the MessagesPage. Ensure the new chat and notifications features are properly wired into the TanStack Router route tree in routeTree.ts with appropriate routes (e.g. /messages, /messages/:principalId).
acceptanceCriteria: Messages route is registered in routeTree.ts and renders the MessagesPage
A direct conversation route (e.g. /messages/:principalId) opens the specific thread
The BottomNav or TopBar includes a navigable Messages entry point
Navigating to /messages while unauthenticated shows a login prompt

requirements.text: Add a 'Send Message' button on UserProfilePage so that an authenticated user can initiate or continue a direct message conversation with that user. Clicking it navigates to /messages/:principalId of that user.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Message' button appears on UserProfilePage for authenticated users
Clicking it navigates to the direct message thread with that user
Unauthenticated users see a disabled or hidden Message button

constraints: Do not modify any existing backend data structures for Posts, Comments, or UserProfile — only add new stable variables for messages, follows, and notifications
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui
Do not remove or alter any existing pages, components, or features already present in the app
All new React Query hooks must be added to frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts following existing patterns
nonGoals: Real-time WebSocket or push-based messaging — polling every 5 seconds is sufficient
